messages:
marta: quick idea  add a "notify provenance" panel in alert flyout so users can see why a given alert hit (or didn’t hit) recipients. saves a ton of why-didnt-i-get-paged tickets.

dev: love it. needs to include routing snapshot, suppression decisions, quota checks, and the exact policy hashes used at delivery time.

owen: also include the matching SLO rule and threshold version. sometimes alerts fire vs a previous SLO definition and owners get confused.

marta: UX: small expandable timeline: event -> policy-eval -> routing decision -> delivery attempts (with status). show delta between expected and actual fanout.

dev: API idea: GET /v1/alerts/:alert_id/provenance returning a compact timeline. sample fields: evaluator_id, policy_id, suppression_reason, recipients_attempted, recipients_delivered, token_estimate.

marta: telemetry: emit provenance_id for each alert so we can correlate. also expose provenance_id as a query param to logs.

own: sce: performance concern: provenance will need to materialize decision snapshots. store lightweight snapshots in notify-store with TTL 30d. heavy events can be truncated.

dev: agree. store policy hashes and pointers to full policy blob. keep the timeline under 5KB typical.

sre-bot: note created: INF-9001  store notify provenance snapshots (+ dashboard).

owen: on console copy  show a short human explanation like "Suppressed by quiet-window: maintenance-utc (23:00-03:00)" and link to full timeline. no jargon by default.

dev: add a small debugging endpoint: POST /v1/alerts/:id/replay-provenance which re-runs routing logic against a stored snapshot for root cause repro. feature-flag this.

marta: rollout: feature flag + internal beta. expose read-only panel to customers first, keep replay internal.

own: security: provenance may include recipient identifiers; hide full emails for non-admins and show hashed ids instead. dev: add a redaction layer.

dev: implementation note: policy changes must be detected: when evaluating an alert, capture active policy refs and store their hash. provenance record = {ts, policy_hashes, decision_steps}.

marta: UX follow-up: when a user clicks "why not notified" from user settings, open the panel with search for recent alerts that targeted them. helpful for oncall debugging.

own: ops ask  add Grafana panels for provenance_written_per_min and average_snapshot_size. sre-bot: acknowledged.

sre-bot: INF-9001 updated with grafana reqs.

dev: will draft small RFC and API contract. keeping payloads compact.

marta: thanks everyone. I’ll mock the flyout panel and add copy samples. :thumbsup:
